reason: The grouped-N wording does not specify a tile mapping and differs from the cited grouped-M4 implementation. Three existing grouped-M4 confirmation attempts are unconfirmed. Existing evidence is inconclusive and additional identical testing has limited expected value.

schedule_distinction.grouped_m4: Implemented GROUP_M=4: traverse four M rows for each N column across all 24 N columns, then advance to the next M group on the FC1 8x24 grid.
schedule_distinction.hypothetical_grouped_n: Grouping four N columns would require a separately specified and reviewed PID-to-tile mapping. The current proposal does not define it; grouped-M4 measurements do not evaluate it.
schedule_distinction.baseline: direct_2d in benchmark_proposal.py; distinct from trusted_two_slab_kernel.py

scope: Only the tested grouped-M4 configuration on FP16 FC1 is inconclusive; no failure classification applies to the entire CTA-ordering family.
replication_guidance: A future controlled replication remains eligible with an explicit rationale, preserved source/configuration identity, existing correctness tolerances, paired timing, matched A/A controls, and a bounded noise-aware decision rule.
